rebuild_all_form_composer_apps: run the rebuild script to clean and rebuild all FormComposer-related apps and packages
clean_build_and_node_modules: run the clean function to remove all build and node_modules directories across FormComposer apps
build_web_apps: run the build function to force rebuild all Mephisto React web apps and packages
rebuild_with_package_locks: run the rebuild script with the --rebuild-package-locks flag to also remove package lock files
clean_mephisto_core_package: run the clean function to remove build and node_modules from the Mephisto core package
